translations.web: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David his father. And his son Ahaz reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
